name: Lakhan Lal
role: Postdoctoral Researcher in Computational Materials Science
intro: I study how atomic structure, electronic transport and catalytic activity come together in materials for energy conversion. At Technion, my work spans electrocatalysis, photocatalysis and zeolites for CO₂-to-fuel conversion.

researchAreas.title: Electrocatalysis
researchAreas.text: Transition-metal oxides and oxyhydroxides for oxygen evolution, water splitting and hydrogen production.

researchAreas.title: Photocatalysis
researchAreas.text: Metal-organic frameworks and functional materials for light-driven hydrogen and ammonia synthesis.

researchAreas.title: Electronic transport
researchAreas.text: First-principles electronic structure and non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) methods to connect conductivity with catalytic performance.

researchAreas.title: Thermal catalysis & electrolysis
researchAreas.text: Functional oxides, solid oxide cells and co-electrolysis of steam and CO₂ for energy conversion.

researchAreas.title: Zeolites & CO₂ conversion
researchAreas.text: Postdoctoral research on zeolites for conversion of CO₂ to fuels.

education.degree: Ph.D. in Materials Science and Engineering
education.institution: Technion – Israel Institute of Technology, Haifa, Israel
education.thesis: Computational Study of Water Oxidation Reaction Activity and Electronic Conductivity in Transition Metal-Doped Nickel Oxyhydroxide Electrocatalysts

gate: Qualified in GATE 2017 (Mechanical Engineering) and GATE 2019 (Engineering Sciences: Thermodynamics and Materials Science).
hobby: Away from the research desk, I enjoy nature photography and spending time with cats. I am a cat person.

foss.title: Open tools. Shared compute. Practical training.
foss.body: I founded FOSS Computations to help researchers learn and use free and open-source scientific software through practical training and computational resources. Our 256-core computation server is installed with scientific software and packages.
foss.focus: Our current focus is materials science. We plan to expand into electronics, machine learning and AI training.
